annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – Recommendations for the next Framework Programme for Research and Innovation (FP10)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – Recommendations for the next Framework Programme for Research and Innovation (FP10)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: Opinion of the EU Committee of the Regions with policy recommendations for FP10, the next EU research and innovation framework programme. It stresses a place-based approach, smart specialisation, regional involvement in partnerships and missions, widening participation, and a protected budget. AI is mentioned only briefly.
key_provisions_or_claims: Place-based approach should guide FP10 strategic programming
Cities and regions should be involved in FP governance, partnerships and missions
Link FP10 with smart specialisation and cohesion policy through multi-fund programming
Ringfence the FP budget in line with the Barcelona 3% GDP objective
AI should operate under ethical guidelines and a robust regulatory framework
